title: veggr
tagline: A PWA that tracks how many different plants you eat each day and each week. 🥦
why: I wanted to know whether I actually eat a variety of plants each week, not just a lot of the same ones.

sections.title: How to run it
body: A Vue 3 + [Vite+](https://viteplus.dev) app (`vp`), installed with pnpm.
